matters.title: GP&L Substation Instrumentation Supplier Contract
matters.text: This request is to obtain a supplier contract for the as-needed purchase of instrumentation devices to be used in GP&L and TMPA substations.

Title: GP&L Substation Instrumentation Supplier Contract
Submitted by: Chuck Chapman, Director of Transmission Services
Bid Number: R EQ00002093
Strategic Focus P rotect Core Services
Area:
Purchase Justification
This request is to obtain a supplier contract for the as-needed purchase of instrumentation devices to be used
in GP&L and TMPA substations. This will be an initial term contract with four optional renewals. Expenses
associated with TMPA will be reimbursed at 100%.

competitive bids were not received, a Bid Recap is not included.

and CIP accounts as incurred.

matters.title: GP&L Oates Substation Structure
matters.text: This request is for the purchase of a factory-built substation to be installed at the GP&L Oates Substation site.

attachments.name: Purchasing/Bid Report
attachments.text:
PURCHASING REPORT
2.e
Meeting Date: February 17, 2026
Title: GP&L Oates Substation Structure
Submitted by: Chuck Chapman, Director of Transmission Services
Bid Number: R EQ00001460
Strategic Focus R eliable / Cost-Efficient Utility Services
Area:
Purchase Justification
This request is for the purchase of a factory-built substation to be installed at the GP&L Oates Substation site.
The prefabricated station will include distribution bus and distribution breaker bays preassembled with mounted
disconnects. This is part of the approved GP&L Oates Substation Rebuild CIP project. Due to the complex
nature of the materials, a 25% owner's contingency is included for any additional material that may be
required.
Evaluation
Dis-Tran Packaged Substations is designated as the sole source provider of the Factory-Built Substation due
to patents and copyrights. As competitive bids were not received, a Bid Recap is not included.
Award Recommendation
Vendor Bid No. Item Amount Basis for Award Purchase Requisition #
Dis-Tran Packaged Solutions REQ00001460 All $1,530,800.00 Sole Source REQ00001460
Fiscal Impact
Funding is available in the GP&L Substations Upgrades CIP Program for the substation in the amount of
$1,530,800, which is within the approved budget of $9,505,000 and will leave a remaining balance of
$2,878,044.
